scope: Legacy-high GF8 AVX2 dense three- and four-parity encoding for K=13 and K=14

implementation.algebra: Accumulate four shifted T=4 inverse LCH transforms for source blocks 0..3, retaining all four coefficient lanes in AVX2 registers, then apply one T=4 forward transform and store only the requested R=3 or R=4 parity prefix.
implementation.fourth_block: K=13 loads one source and three shortened zero lanes; K=14 loads two sources and two shortened zero lanes. The fixed inverse skew tables use indices 13, 15, and 14 in the legacy coordinate order.
implementation.public_fast_layout: Dense packed source and parity slabs for exact shard sizes 64, 128, 256, 512, 1024, and 1984 bytes.
implementation.reusable_binding: Homogeneous dense prevalidated bindings use one prepared-table batch circuit for 32-byte multiples through 16384 bytes and amortize table setup across stripes.
implementation.fallback: K=12, K=15, K=16, ragged sizes, sparse outputs, detached slabs, aliases, and byte counts outside the qualified public set retain the mature transform path.
implementation.backend_scope: The large four-block generated kernels are emitted only in the AVX2 member; AVX-512 and GFNI retain their previously qualified paths pending independent measurements.
implementation.neighbor_stabilization: A compact shape classifier and a one-item K=4/R=4/B=64 register-resident route removed the initial 5.3 percent same-source K=4 regression while multi-stripe K=4 bindings retain table amortization.

methodology.statistic: Mean of five independent log-contrasts with a two-sided Student-t 95 percent confidence interval.
methodology.ratio_orientation: Comparator encode time divided by candidate encode time.
methodology.isolation_result: Frozen hashes were unchanged. The reserved SMT sibling accumulated zero non-idle jiffies in the same-source campaign and two in the exact-main campaign.

same_source.only_credible_control_loss: K=4/R=3/B=64 at ratio 0.9911693713; magnitude is below one percent.

correctness.independent_oracle: The 1024-profile direct systematic generator suite passed 50,064,849 Release parity-symbol comparisons; the sanitizer build passed 50,111,649 comparisons.
correctness.t4_contract_matrix: K=13/14, R=3/4, every promoted byte count, unaligned packed slabs, public and one-item batch execution, forced-transform fallbacks, ragged boundaries, sparse outputs, detached slabs, input aliases, overlap rejection, exact scratch, and failure atomicity passed.
correctness.binding_matrix: The production high-direct test passed 1,489 T=4 binding checks; allocation, aliasing, changed-source, concurrency, and repeated-execution checks passed.
correctness.legacy_compatibility: Every promoted parity output matched both the independent generator and Leopard1 byte-for-byte.
correctness.clang18_asan_ubsan_lsan: Packed terminal, production archive, binding, allocation/aliasing, concurrency, and full direct-generator tests passed with no diagnostic.
correctness.field_builds: Final GF8-only and GF16-only production archives built successfully.

rejected_variants.K12_K15_K16_register_fusion: Correct but rejected. The initial screen regressed the prior Leopard2 path at multiple byte counts: representative prior/new ratios were about 0.93 for K=12/B=1024, 0.94 for K=15/B=1024, and 0.90 for K=16/B=256. Register pressure and code shape outweighed eliminated memory passes.
rejected_variants.unisolated_first_promotion: Rejected after the first same-source campaign found a 5.3 percent K=4/R=4/B=64 regression. Compact classification and the exact one-item route removed regressions beyond two percent before final promotion.

disposition: Promote K=13/14. All exact-main and same-source selected cells are credible wins, no same-source control regresses beyond two percent, the binding matrix has no credible loss, and all correctness, sanitizer, compatibility, and optional-field build gates pass.
